    Mistral AI Setup

    Guide to setting up Mistral AI for OCR text extraction.

    Prerequisites

    • Mistral AI account
    • Credit card for API usage

    Step 1: Create Account

    1. Go to https://console.mistral.ai
    2. Sign up or log in
    3. Complete account setup

    Step 2: Get API Key

    1. In dashboard, go to API Keys
    2. Click Create API Key
    3. Enter key name: "nolain-ocr"
    4. Copy the API key (starts with xxx)
    5. Save securely - shown only once
    6. Add to .env file: env MISTRAL_API_KEY=xxx

    Step 3: Add Payment Method

    1. Go to Billing
    2. Click Add Payment Method
    3. Enter credit card details
    4. Set usage limits (optional but recommended)

    Models Used

    Mistral Small (Vision)

    Model ID: mistral-small-latest

    Capabilities: - Image understanding (OCR) - Text extraction - Structured JSON output - Multi-language support

    Pricing: (check current rates on Mistral website) - Per token pricing - Batch API discount available

    API Usage

    Single Image Extraction

    Endpoint: /v1/chat/completions

    Example Request:

    response = mistral_client.chat.complete(
    model="mistral-small-latest",
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "image_url",
                "image_url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{base64_image}"
            },
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": "Extract all text and data from this image as structured JSON."
            }
        ]
    }]
)

    Batch API

    Use Case: Processing >50 images efficiently

    Advantages: - Lower cost per request - Parallel processing - Automatic retries

    Flow: 1. Upload images 2. Create batch job 3. Poll for completion 4. Download results

    Rate Limits

    Check Current Limits: Mistral Dashboard → API Keys

    Typical Limits: - Requests per minute - Tokens per minute - Concurrent requests

    Recommendations: - Implement exponential backoff - Use batch API for large jobs - Monitor usage in dashboard

    Cost Optimization

    Tips

    1. Use Batch API: Lower cost for bulk processing
    2. Compress Images: Smaller images = fewer tokens
    3. Monitor Usage: Set up alerts in dashboard
    4. Cache Results: Don't re-process same documents

    Example Costs

    (Check current pricing on Mistral website)

    Single Image: - Input: ~1000 tokens (image + prompt) - Output: ~500 tokens (JSON response) - Cost: $0.XX per extraction

    Batch (100 images): - Cost per image: Lower with batch discount

    Testing

    Test API Key

    curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MISTRAL_API_KEY"

    Expected: List of available models

    Test Extraction

    1. Start your application
    2. Upload a document
    3. Click extract
    4. Check Mistral dashboard for API usage

    Monitoring

    Dashboard Metrics

    Usage Tab: - Requests per day - Tokens consumed - Costs

    Set Alerts: - Daily usage limit - Monthly cost limit

    Common Issues

    "Invalid API key"

    • Cause: Wrong key or expired
    • Solution: Generate new key in dashboard

    "Rate limit exceeded"

    • Cause: Too many requests
    • Solution: Implement rate limiting, use batch API

    "Model not found"

    • Cause: Wrong model ID
    • Solution: Use mistral-small-latest

    Environment Variables

    Add to .env:

    MISTRAL_API_KEY=xxx

    SDK Installation

    Python:

    pip install mistralai

    Included in: backend/requirements.txt
